summary: Completed comprehensive backend testing of DateParserService, follow-up automation, and worker system functionality. The enhanced date parsing capabilities are working excellently with minor edge cases.

minor_bugs.issue: Returns 29 days instead of 30 for 'after 30 days' pattern
minor_bugs.impact: Off-by-one error in day calculation for specific patterns

minor_bugs.issue: Returns 2 days instead of 3 for 'couple/few days' patterns
minor_bugs.impact: Vague day references use 2 instead of expected 3 days

minor_bugs.issue: Q2/Q3/Q4 quarter notation not always recognized in complex sentences
minor_bugs.impact: Alternative quarter notation (Q2 vs 'next quarter') may not be parsed

working_features: ✅ Enhanced DateParserService with season support (summer=June 21, winter=Dec 21, spring=Mar 20, fall=Sep 22)
✅ Day range support (10-15 days correctly returns midpoint at 11-12 days)
✅ Simple day parsing (after 30 days works, minor off-by-one issue)
✅ Year boundary parsing (beginning/end of year, fiscal year=April 1st)
✅ Named day parsing (next Monday correctly calculates weekdays)
✅ Multiple date reference handling (finds 2+ dates in complex text)
✅ False positive prevention (correctly ignores non-date time units)
✅ Edge case handling (80% success rate on complex patterns)
✅ Background workers running (email polling, follow-up checking, reminders)
